canonical_plan.active_item: 77.44.7.D / D-06; EDT-037 keyboard alternative for Canvas element movement

finding: Pointer dragging had no equivalent for a keyboard-only user to reposition a selected Canvas element. The existing Page Model command and undo history support responsive geometry updates, so native keyboard controls can use the same path without changing Save/Publish semantics.

details: The selected, effectively-unlocked non-root Canvas element exposes a focusable move control. Arrow keys move by one CSS pixel; Shift plus an arrow moves by ten CSS pixels. Modified browser/system shortcuts are not intercepted.
Movement uses the existing responsive.set command/history with a per-node/device typing group, rerenders and restores focus to the control, and announces the new location in the live status region.
Root and effectively-locked nodes do not expose the control. The responsive geometry stays in the Page Model; movement does not autosave or publish.
The editor cache-bust token and its regression assertion were updated; generated source traceability was rebuilt.
change.third_party_code_or_dependency: NONE; native HTML button and existing Editor command/history APIs are used.

assertions: Keyboard movement and 1px/10px step geometry at mobile and desktop viewports.
Undo/Redo restore and reapply movement without a remote write.
Save stores the Page Model draft and reload preserves responsive geometry; published state stays unchanged until explicit Publish.
Root and locked elements cannot be moved through the Canvas keyboard control.
